newsitem.title: INDIA: NBC Asia launches digital TV service in India.
newsitem.headline: NBC Asia launches digital TV service in India.

text.p: NBC Asia on Thursday announced the impending launch in India of its entertainment and news channel, NBC Asia, and its business channel, CNBC.
NBC Asia will be introducing digital television service in India through these two channels, which will begin broadcasting in November, officials said.
NBC Asia president S.K. Fung told a news conference that both channels will be part of NewsCorp's STAR Television platform on the AsiaSat 2 satellite.
NBC Asia has also signed an agreement with In Cable, a leading cable television firm owned by the British-based Hinduja family which has access to about two million homes.
Television Eighteen (TV18) will be NBC Asia's programming partner and will make Indian entertainment programmes and general features for NBC Asia.
TV18 will, however, not produce programmes for CNBC.
NBC is setting up a studio in Bombay to produce its Indin programmes.
